# Dreative executable native foundations

Search the small machine-readable system set after selecting an advanced need:

    dreative catalogue --query "persistent product" --json

The catalogue deliberately contains twelve systems rather than a vocabulary of
effects. Each record links executable source, a functional visual fixture,
appropriate and bad uses, mobile/reduced-motion behavior, cleanup, a performance
budget, and browser checks.

The compiled registry is `dist/shared/creativeCatalog.js`. Source and examples
are in `systems/runtime.js`, `systems/NATIVE_FOUNDATIONS.md`, and
`systems/demo.html`. Advanced runtime selection is in
`references/CREATIVE_EXECUTION.md`; where to source real imagery, texture, 3D,
or type is in `references/MEDIA_SOURCES.md`; build-time media work is in
`references/ASSET_PIPELINES.md`. The system set is an implementation lookup
after a project-native concept has been chosen. It must never supply the concept
or a named site's house style.

`exemplars/SLOP.md` lists the default shapes that make generated frontends
recognisable as generated, and `exemplars/PRINCIPLES.md` holds principles
indexed by the condition under which they apply. Neither contains copied
designs: a library of examples converges the output on its own average, which is
the failure being avoided. Read `exemplars/SLOP.md` before committing to a
visual system.

Named reference and library candidates are routed by
`references/REFERENCE_ADOPTION.md`. That guide separates useful full-site and
product-flow research from conditional component or mechanism sources,
specialist data or app-presentation tools, competing animation owners, and
unrelated builders.
